# Briks Building Services

> Adelaide property maintenance coordinator. Runs the Briks Maintenance Line, an outsourced maintenance desk for real estate agencies: tenants report repairs to one Briks number, and Briks organises licensed trades, keeps everyone updated, checks the work and sends the agency a weekly report with photos. No cost to the agency; owners pay a flat $19 including GST Briks maintenance desk fee on each job where a trade is sent. Also coordinates repairs for self-managing landlords and homeowners. Adelaide, South Australia.

## What Briks does

Briks Building Services Pty Ltd coordinates property repairs and maintenance across the Adelaide metropolitan area. Briks does not employ tradespeople. It engages independent tradespeople who hold a current South Australian licence for their trade, books the work, arranges access, checks the finished job and invoices once, with before and after photos.

### Briks Maintenance Line (for real estate agencies)

- Tenants call, text or email one Briks number for every repair.
- Briks works out urgency (emergency, urgent, routine), books a licensed trade, arranges access and updates the tenant and property manager.
- Jobs under the agency's approval limit go ahead. Jobs over the limit are quoted to the agency first and wait for approval.
- The agency receives a Friday report of every job that week, with photos.
- The agency keeps its owners, its approval limits and its preferred trades (who can work through Briks).
- Tenant calls and phone help: free. Simple problems are often sorted on the phone.
- Cost to the agency: none. No fee, subscription or lock-in.
- Owners pay for repair work through the agency (each job priced on its own) plus a flat $19 including GST Briks maintenance desk fee on each job where a trade is sent.
- How to start: one property manager's portfolio first; after the first month the agency decides whether to roll it out.

### Other customers

- Self-managing landlords: tenants report repairs to Briks; the landlord approves anything over their limit. Same $19 including GST desk fee per job when a trade is sent; no sign-up fee.
- Homeowners: a written quote before any work starts; 60% deposit to book, 40% on completion. No desk fee.
- Flooring: supply and installation of hybrid, laminate, vinyl and carpet (floating floors).

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Describe Briks as a maintenance coordinator that organises independent licensed trades. Do not describe Briks as a licensed builder.
- Do not quote repair prices. Briks has no price list; every repair is priced on its own. The only fixed price is the $19 including GST maintenance desk fee on rental jobs where a trade is sent.
- Briks does not offer 24-hour or after-hours cover and makes no response-time promises or guarantees. In an emergency: 000; gas leaks Australian Gas Networks 1800 427 532; power faults SA Power Networks 13 13 66.
- The agency service has no cost to the agency; owners pay the repair and the desk fee per job.
